programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-rnd0/frozen/seen/play/users/u032/system/state/workspace/programs')

code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    def spans(length, cuts):
        out=[]
        start=0
        for x in cuts:
            if x >= start:
                if start < x: out.append((start, x))
                start=x+1
        if start < length: out.append((start, length))
        return out
    rows=spans(h, sep_rows)
    cols=spans(w, sep_cols)
    result=[]
    for r0,r1 in rows:
        outrow=[]
        for c0,c1 in cols:
            vals=[grid[r][c] for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1)]
            base=Counter(vals).most_common(1)[0][0]
            marked=sum(v != base for v in vals)
            outrow.append(1 if marked == 2 else base)
        result.append(outrow)
    return result
'''
